description: Source code implementing methods for various reftable record types, including encoding, decoding, comparison, and management of reference, log, index, and object records.

methods.name: get_var_int
methods.description: Decodes a variable-length integer from a string_view into a uint64_t destination.

methods.name: put_var_int
methods.description: Encodes a uint64_t value into a variable-length integer in a string_view.

methods.name: reftable_is_block_type
methods.description: Checks if a given type byte corresponds to a valid reftable block type.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_val1
methods.description: Returns the val1 pointer from a reference record based on its value type.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_val2
methods.description: Returns the val2 target_value pointer from a reference record based on its value type.

methods.name: decode_string
methods.description: Decodes a string from a reftable_buf and string_view, returning the number of bytes consumed.

methods.name: encode_string
methods.description: Encodes a C string into a string_view buffer, returning the number of bytes written.

methods.name: reftable_encode_key
methods.description: Encodes a key with prefix and suffix lengths, handling common prefix optimization.

methods.name: reftable_decode_keylen
methods.description: Decodes key length components and extra byte from a string_view.

methods.name: reftable_decode_key
methods.description: Decodes a key from a string_view, updating last_key buffer.

methods.name: reftable_record_key
methods.description: Retrieves the key for a record using its vtable.

methods.name: reftable_record_encode
methods.description: Encodes a record into a string_view using its vtable.

methods.name: reftable_record_copy_from
methods.description: Copies data from one record to another using their vtable.

methods.name: reftable_record_val_type
methods.description: Returns the value type of a record.

methods.name: reftable_record_decode
methods.description: Decodes a record from a string_view using its vtable.

methods.name: reftable_record_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a record.

methods.name: reftable_record_is_deletion
methods.description: Checks if a record is marked as a deletion.

methods.name: reftable_record_cmp
methods.description: Compares two records and sets comparison result.

methods.name: reftable_record_equal
methods.description: Checks if two records are equal.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_equal
methods.description: Checks if two reference records are equal.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_compare_name
methods.description: Compares reference record names.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_is_deletion
methods.description: Checks if a reference record is a deletion.

methods.name: reftable_log_record_compare_key
methods.description: Compares log records by key.

methods.name: reftable_log_record_is_deletion
methods.description: Checks if a log record is a deletion.

methods.name: reftable_record_init
methods.description: Initializes a reftable_record with a specified type.
